item.description: Frank looked forward to lunch at Pacific Catch in Santa Monica, and it meant a lot to share that time together. A simple outing filled with kindness and connection.

item.title: They say, “At your age…” But you’ve never been this
item.description: A gentle reminder to live, laugh, and share life without letting age define you. Embrace your inner child and be kind to one another.
